name: Dong Hoi
provinceNote: Resolution 202/2025/QH15 merged Quảng Bình into Quảng Trị, effective 12 June 2025, with the new provincial government from 1 July 2025. The ward office prints 88 Phạm Văn Đồng, phường Đồng Hới, tỉnh Quảng Trị. Visitor pages still say Quảng Bình.
dotReason: Worth a night on the beach before the caves
summary: A small coastal city in central Vietnam with a river-mouth beach and the airport for the Phong Nha caves. Walk Nhat Le beach and the riverfront, see the old citadel gate and the ruined Tam Toa bell tower, and buy sun-dried sweet potato at the market. One night suits travellers on their way to the caves.
getThere: Dong Hoi Airport (VVDH), 6 km north. Rail from Hue is about three hours on the 21 Oct 2026 board. Road minutes are check on arrival.
seoTitle: Dong Hoi travel guide — a beach night, then the caves
seoDescription: Sleep on Nhật Lệ, 6 km south of the airport. Phong Nha Cave is 50 km southeast. Beach fees, gate hours, and the Hue road are check on arrival.
intro: You come for the mouth of the Nhật Lệ. Sand, small surf, fishing boats, and the older bridge sit in one frame, with the city on the near bank and Bảo Ninh’s coconuts across the water. The ward page names sunset as the hour for the beach. The coast of the old city is given as 12 km. Nhật Lệ 2 is the night shape that page describes: one A-tower, two spans of 150 m, and a tower of 98 m, lit after dark. This page has no photograph of the whole tower, so the bridge is not a sight card.

Stay if the beach night is the point. Head for Phong Nha village if the boat cave is the trip. The park puts Phong Nha Cave 50 km southeast of Đồng Hới and does not print the minutes. The ward page says about 50 km and does not name the compass point. Do not pair the beach with a same-day cave and a same-day flight. Head for Hue if the citadel is the trip. The rail posts are 166 km apart. That figure is the railway, not the highway.

The center walk is the gate, the short walls, Tam Toa, and the statue. Quảng Bình Quan is the south gate of the Lũy Thầy line, not a Hue citadel. The ward page says Đào Duy Từ had the rampart built in 1631, the gate rebuilt in brick and stone in 1825, and repaired in 1961. A shorter visitor note dates the Nguyễn lords’ work from 1630. The portal says bombs nearly destroyed the gate in 1965 and it was restored again. The citadel survives as short sections, a moat, an east gate, and an arched bridge toward the river. Tam Toa is the ruined bell tower in the central park. Mother Suốt is the memorial of a wartime ferry, not a working boat.

Bảo Ninh is the peninsula across the river, still this city. The ward page describes a long straight beach, a whale temple, and an old rampart. The walking street on Phan Bội Châu and Đồng Hải is about 1 km, printed as 18:00–24:00 on Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and holidays. One source. On other nights that page sends you to the river path and the sunset, and it does not name a bar street. On site you can rent a bicycle, a motorbike, an electric car, or a taxi. No fare is printed.
gettingAround: Đồng Hới Airport is VVDH on the civil AIP, titled Quang Binh/Dong Hoi, run by Airports Corporation of Vietnam. It sits 6 km north of the center, elevation 18 m, IFR/VFR. IATA code VDH is the code in common use. Which cities have a nonstop is check on arrival. Minutes and a taxi fare from the terminal are check on arrival.

Ga Đồng Hới is on the Vietnam Railways board at km 522 southbound and km 1204 northbound. Huế is 166 km by those posts. Example clocks from the board read on 21 Oct 2026 are on the Hue route. They are not a promise that the clock never changes. Fares were not copied. The station street and the bus station are check on arrival. Road minutes from Hue are check on arrival.

The ward page says you can rent a bicycle, a motorbike, an electric car, or a taxi. No operator and no fare. Nhật Lệ is described as in the city. Bảo Ninh is the far bank. The gate, the market, Tam Toa, and the short walls are a walk from a riverside room. Minutes between them are check on arrival. The airport is 6 km, not a walk from the terminal with bags.

stayAreas.name: Nhật Lệ beachfront
stayAreas.summary: Sleep on the city sand if sunset is the reason for the night. The ward page puts the beach in the center, under casuarina, not on a highway outside town.

stayAreas.name: Bảo Ninh
stayAreas.summary: The peninsula across the Nhật Lệ, still Đồng Hới, not another city. A long straight beach the ward page calls the quiet swim. Cross by the bridge.

stayAreas.name: River streets
stayAreas.summary: A room by the market and Quảng Bình Quan if the morning is the river walk. The gate, the statue, and Chợ Đồng Hới are on that bank.

eat: Khoai deo is red sweet potato boiled, sliced, and sun-dried 9–12 days until the slice is chestnut brown and leathery. Buy it at Chợ Đồng Hới or chợ Nam Lý and take it home. A price is Check on arrival. Nam Lý is a buy-line, not a second market.

Cháo canh is the everyday bowl, and bánh khoái is the crisp rice-batter cake with a pork, tomato, and pineapple sauce. It is not the Hue crepe. Bánh bột lọc, bánh bèo, bánh xèo, and kẹo cu đơ sit with them. Stalls at Chợ Đồng Hới sell mostly in the early morning and the afternoon. Hours are Check on arrival.
interestsBody: Khoai deo is the sun-dried sweet. Cháo canh and bánh khoái are the everyday plates. Chợ Đồng Hới is the market on Mẹ Suốt.
Nhật Lệ is a city beach at the river mouth, with the morning walk on the same water. Bảo Ninh is the far bank, not a second destination.
Quảng Bình Quan and the short citadel walls are a gate and a few restored stretches. They are not a Hue citadel day.
Tam Toa is a ruined bell tower in the central park. Mother Suốt is the memorial of the wartime ferry beside the river.

interestGroups.title: Nhật Lệ
interestGroups.summary: The beach is in the city, at the mouth, and the river walk is the same morning.
body: The ward page puts Nhật Lệ in the city: pale sand, casuarina, fishing boats at the mouth, and sunset as the hour. The old city coast is given as 12 km. A fee and the hours are check on arrival.

The morning walk looks across to Bảo Ninh’s coconuts and the boats. The bridge in these frames is the older Nhật Lệ span, begun in June 2002, 635 m by 12 m with 15 spans. It is not Nhật Lệ 2. Bảo Ninh itself is an area of this city. Bàu Tró, the freshwater lake, has no second licensed frame, so it stays off the cards.

blocks.heading: The city beach
paragraphs: Sit on the sand at the mouth. The ward page calls the water clear and names sunset. Do not treat the beach as a stop between a cave and a flight. The park puts Phong Nha Cave 50 km southeast and does not print the minutes.

blocks.heading: The morning river
paragraphs: Walk the banks early. The ward page points at coconuts on the far bank and boats on the water. No promenade fee was printed. The time on the path is check on arrival.

cards.title: Nhat Le Beach
cards.summary: Pale sand under casuarina at the river mouth. Sunset is the named hour. The fee and the hours are check on arrival. The cave is 50 km away.

cards.title: Nhat Le riverbank
cards.summary: The morning walk, with boats, coconuts, and the older bridge. Not Nhật Lệ 2. No promenade fee was printed.

interestGroups.title: The gate and the short walls
interestGroups.summary: Quảng Bình Quan explains the city mark. The citadel is the short walls beside it, not a court visit.
body: The portal calls Quảng Bình Quan the south gate, Cổng Hạ, of the Lũy Thầy line. Print both 1630 and 1631. The 1825 rebuild and the 1961 repair are on the ward page. The portal adds the near-destruction in 1965 and the later name Định Bắc trường thành.

Thành Đồng Hới is not a complete imperial city. The ward page says more than 200 years of wall remain only in pieces, with a moat, an east gate, and an arched bridge. Ho Chi Minh Square, 6.8 ha on Hùng Vương inside the same area, has no licensed photograph and is not a card.

blocks.heading: The south gate
paragraphs: Look at the brick gate in daylight. A tour card prints a free label. No separate gate tariff was opened. The fee and the hours are check on arrival. The street number is check on arrival.

blocks.heading: The short walls
paragraphs: Walk the restored stretches with the gate. The heritage list places Thành Đồng Hới in Đồng Hải. The ward page places the remaining walls in the old Hải Định ward. Use both. Do not promise a Hue citadel.

cards.title: Quang Binh Gate
cards.summary: The south gate of the Lũy Thầy line, brick and stone from the 1825 rebuild. Not a Hue citadel. Fee and hours are check on arrival.

cards.title: Dong Hoi Citadel
cards.summary: Short restored walls, a moat, an east gate, and an arched bridge. The square inside the same area has no photograph here.

interestGroups.title: Tam Toa and the ferry
interestGroups.summary: Two war relics inside a center walk: a ruined bell tower, and the memorial of a ferry.
body: Tam Toa is the bell tower left in the central park. The ward page says the church was built in 1886 and reduced, in the American war years it dates 1964–1972, to the tower. It is not a service and not a museum. The same page hedges a 1912 baptism of Hàn Mặc Tử. That line is not settled here.

Mother Suốt is the national historic landing where Nguyễn Thị Suốt rowed crossings under bombing and was killed on one of them. She was named Hero of Labor on 1 January 1967. The statue is the pin. It is not a boat you board.

blocks.heading: The ruined tower
paragraphs: See the tower in daylight so the broken masonry reads. No street number was on the ward page or the heritage list. The fee and the hours are check on arrival.

blocks.heading: The memorial landing
paragraphs: The ministry places the site at thôn Trung Bính, Bảo Ninh. A visitor note puts the statue about 1 km from the older Nhật Lệ bridge, on Quách Xuân Kỳ. The ward page puts it beside the river and the market on Mẹ Suốt. The fee is check on arrival.

cards.title: Tam Toa bell tower
cards.summary: The ruined bell tower in the central park, built in 1886 and reduced to the shaft. Not a church service. Fee and hours are check on arrival.

cards.title: Mother Suot
cards.summary: The statue and the wartime ferry landing on the Nhật Lệ. Not a working boat. The fee is check on arrival.

season.label: Sunset on Nhật Lệ
season.note: No storm calendar was opened. The ward page names sunset, not a month, as the hour for Nhật Lệ. The culture-and-tourism week is described as yearly around 30 April and 1 May. The 2023 run stays in the dossier. A date for this year is check on arrival.

faqs.a: Đồng Hới Airport, VVDH on the civil AIP, 6 km north of the center, elevation 18 m, run by Airports Corporation of Vietnam. IATA code VDH is the code in common use. Which cities have a nonstop, and the minutes from the terminal, are check on arrival.

faqs.q: Is Phong Nha in Dong Hoi?
faqs.a: No. The park puts Phong Nha Cave 50 km southeast of Đồng Hới. The ward page says about 50 km and does not name the compass point. Minutes are check on arrival. Sleep in Phong Nha village if the boat is the trip.

faqs.q: Is Dong Hoi in Quang Binh or Quang Tri?
faqs.a: The ward office prints phường Đồng Hới, tỉnh Quảng Trị, at 88 Phạm Văn Đồng. Resolution 202/2025/QH15 merged Quảng Bình into Quảng Trị, effective 12 June 2025, with the new provincial government from 1 July 2025. Visitor pages still say Quảng Bình.

faqs.q: When does the walking street run?
faqs.a: The ward page prints 18:00–24:00 on Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and holidays, about 1 km on Phan Bội Châu and Đồng Hải. One source. Check the current week. No bar street was named.
